name: prospectus
description: PROSPECTUS — course progression platform for Mirai School of Technology

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
